Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Andrew Coy <A....@massey.ac.nz> wrote:
>Can Backways give +1 stealth to a gangrel ally like renegade guru or just
>to gangrel vamps ??

Only non-Caitiff vampires belong to clans, so Backways cannot help
Gangrel allies.

>Does renegade guru do 2 strikes of 2 damage i.e. total 4 damage per round

Yes.

>If someone Computer hacks with a laptop computer is this a bleed for 3 or
>4 blood ?? (A friends argument is that the laptop computer gives a +1
>bleed to the vamp (bleed for 2) and then the computer hacks for a +1
>bleed (for another 2), but I reckon it's a straight 1 +1 +1 = 3 bleed !!)

It's just 1 + 1 + 1 = 3 bleed.

>Can Mob connections be tapped to press a combat the controlling minion
>(of mob connections) is not involved in ??

No. You can only provide presses (of any kind) for combats you're
involved in. So you can't use Police Department on random combats, either.

Messages.Author: Andrew Coy
Messages.Body:
A few questions I couldn't find answers to in any errata/ruling lists..

Can Backways give +1 stealth to a gangrel ally like renegade guru or just
to gangrel vamps ??

Does renegade guru do 2 strikes of 2 damage i.e. total 4 damage per round
??

If someone Computer hacks with a laptop computer is this a bleed for 3 or
4 blood ?? (A friends argument is that the laptop computer gives a +1
bleed to the vamp (bleed for 2) and then the computer hacks for a +1
bleed (for another 2), but I reckon it's a straight 1 +1 +1 = 3 bleed !!)

Can Mob connections be tapped to press a combat the controlling minion

(of mob connections) is not involved in ??

Thanks heaps in advance for any help...

Andrew

Messages.Author: Mark Amidon
Messages.Body:
Andrew Coy <A....@massey.ac.nz> writes:
>Subject: A few questions...
>Date: 23 May 1995 01:33:12 GMT

>A few questions I couldn't find answers to in any errata/ruling lists.

[...renegade guru questions deleted as I don't know the card...]

>If someone Computer hacks with a laptop computer is this a bleed for 3 or

>4 blood ?? (A friend's argument is that the laptop computer gives a +1

>bleed to the vamp (bleed for 2) and then the computer hacks for a +1
>bleed (for another 2), but I reckon it's a straight 1 +1 +1 = 3 bleed !!)

The computer doesn't hack. The minion hacks with the computer. The laptop
ostensibly gives the hacker sufficient leverage to add one more to the
bleed, so the sum total of 3 is correct.

[...Mob Connections question deleted for the same reason as above...]
